narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On July 7, 2024, at approximately 1620 hours, Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered the subject and his brother at a roadside fruit stand near Benton Harbor, Michigan. Both stated that they are citizens of Mexico without documents; the brother is documented on a separate record.
HISTORY:
The subject stated that Border Patrol agents caught him near Calexico, California, in 2013, that he was given expedited removal, and that he was bused to Mexicali the next day.
The subject stated that his brother was arrested in Texas once but was let go.
The subject said that he crossed again near Calexico in 2014.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
Warrant of Arrest and Notice to Appear.
